import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] binomial = new long[777][777];
    static int R, C;
    static long totalCombinations;
    static long minDifference = 1000000000000000000L;
    static long bestValue = -1;
    static char[] seq;
    static int[] prefixA;
    static int[] prefixB;
    static Map<Long, Long> memo_table;

    static void branch_and_bound(long valueX, long valueY, int idxX, int idxY) {
        long diff = Math.abs(valueX - valueY);
        if (minDifference <= 1 || diff - binomial[idxX][R] * binomial[idxY][R] >= minDifference)
            return;

        if (idxX == R - 1 && idxY == R - 1) {
            long currentDiff = Math.abs(valueX - valueY);
            if (currentDiff < minDifference) {
                minDifference = currentDiff;
                bestValue = valueX;
            }
            return;
        }

        if (idxX >= R) {
            long diffX = binomial[idxX][R] - binomial[idxX - 1][R];
            long sumY = binomial[idxY][R];
            branch_and_bound(valueX, valueY + diffX * sumY, idxX - 1, idxY);
        }

        if (idxY >= R) {
            long sumX = binomial[idxX][R];
            long diffY = binomial[idxY][R] - binomial[idxY - 1][R];
            branch_and_bound(valueX + sumX * diffY, valueY, idxX, idxY - 1);
        }
    }

    static long count_paths(long leftScore, long rightScore, int xIndex, int yIndex) {
        long hash = ((long)leftScore << 32) | ((long)xIndex << 16) | (long)yIndex;
        Long found = memo_table.get(hash);
        if (found != null) {
            return found;
        }

        long diff = Math.abs(leftScore - rightScore);
        if (diff - binomial[xIndex][R] * binomial[yIndex][R] > minDifference) {
            memo_table.put(hash, 0L);
            return 0;
        }

        if (xIndex < R || yIndex < R) {
            int stepCount = xIndex + yIndex;
            if (xIndex >= prefixA[stepCount] && yIndex >= prefixB[stepCount]) {
                int adjustedX = xIndex - prefixA[stepCount];
                int adjustedY = yIndex - prefixB[stepCount];
                long result = binomial[adjustedX + adjustedY][adjustedX];
                memo_table.put(hash, result);
                return result;
            }
            memo_table.put(hash, 0L);
            return 0;
        }

        long answer = 0;
        char current_char = seq[xIndex + yIndex - 1];
        if (current_char != 'B') {
            long incrementX = binomial[xIndex][R] - binomial[xIndex - 1][R];
            long sumY = binomial[yIndex][R];
            answer += count_paths(leftScore, rightScore + incrementX * sumY, xIndex - 1, yIndex);
        }
        if (current_char != 'A') {
            long sumX = binomial[xIndex][R];
            long incrementY = binomial[yIndex][R] - binomial[yIndex - 1][R];
            answer += count_paths(leftScore + sumX * incrementY, rightScore, xIndex, yIndex - 1);
        }
        memo_table.put(hash, answer);
        return answer;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        R = scanner.nextInt();
        C = scanner.nextInt();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (R + C); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * (R + C); ++j) {
                if (j == 0) {
                    binomial[i][j] = 1;
                } else if (i == 0) {
                    binomial[i][j] = 0;
                } else {
                    binomial[i][j] = binomial[i - 1][j] + binomial[i - 1][j - 1];
                }
            }
        }

        totalCombinations = binomial[R + C][R] * binomial[R + C][R];

        {
            long valX = 0, valY = 0;
            int idxX = R + C, idxY = R + C;
            while (idxX >= R && idxY >= R) {
                if (valX > valY) {
                    long diffX = binomial[idxX][R] - binomial[idxX - 1][R];
                    long sumY = binomial[idxY][R];
                    valY += diffX * sumY;
                    idxX--;
                } else {
                    long sumX = binomial[idxX][R];
                    long diffY = binomial[idxY][R] - binomial[idxY - 1][R];
                    valX += sumX * diffY;
                    idxY--;
                }
            }
            minDifference = Math.abs(valX - valY);
        }

        branch_and_bound(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        seq = scanner.next().toCharArray();
        prefixA = new int[2 * (R + C) + 1];
        prefixB = new int[2 * (R + C) + 1];
        prefixA[0] = prefixB[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); ++i) {
            prefixA[i + 1] = prefixA[i] + (seq[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            prefixB[i + 1] = prefixB[i] + (seq[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        memo_table = new HashMap<>();
        long finalCount = count_paths(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        System.out.println(finalCount);
    }
}
